newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste to tighten up crude trading rules.
newsitem.headline: Neste to tighten up crude trading rules.

text.p: Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy said on Tuesday its supervisory board had decided to tighten procedures and reporting in its crude oil trading division following sharp losses it reported earlier this year.
The supervisory board said an earlier introduced change of focus in Neste's oil trading business and the new more stringent authorisation and reporting instructions will help avoid future losses.
The 285 million markka crude oil trading "sales margin deficit" announced on July 26 "resulted from inefficient risk analyses, among other things," Neste said on Tuesday.
Neste said it had decided to make "fundamental clarifications to the trading unit's powers, authorisation procedures and reporting practice", but did not elaborate.
Neste announced on September 9 that Eija Malmivirta, the former head of its oil trading and supply division, had left the company. No reason was given for her resignation.
Last Friday, Neste said Wouter Boomsma had been appointed new head of the oil trading unit from October 1.
